newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Portucel to raise BEKP price from July 1.
newsitem.headline: Portucel to raise BEKP price from July 1.

text.p: Portuguese pulp group Portucel Industrial-Empresa Produtora de Celulose will raise the price of Bleached Eucalyptus Kraft Pulp (BEKP) by 40 ecus per tonne to 490 ecus per tonne with effect from July 1, a company official said.

"Portucel decided this morning to announce to distributors on its international network that from July 1 the BEKP price will be 490 ecus per tonne," Vitor Coelho, director of investor relations, told Reuters.
Portucel shares stood at 1,340 escudos, up 84, in volume of 683,947 shares at 1159 GMT.
